sentences.text:
**
Jagmohan Bansal, J. (Oral)

1.  The petitioner through instant petition under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India is seeking setting aside of appointment of respondent No.7 as Constable (HAP-Durga-1).
2.
The petitioner and respondent No.7 pursuant to Advertisement No.4/2020 under Scheduled Caste Category applied for the post of Constable.
Respondent No.7 was denied appointment letter on account of her implication in FIR dated 22.09.2020 under Section 376 of IPC.
The Investigating Officer filed cancellation report, which was accepted by Judicial Magistrate, First Class.
She filed CWP-8875-2024 before this Court seeking direction to respondent to issue her appointment letter.
The said petition was disposed of vide order dated 02.05.2025.
The respondent issued appointment letter and she joined service.

The petitioner is assailing appointment of respondent No.7 on the ground that she secured appointment on the basis of Haryana Resident Certificate as well as Scheduled Caste Certificate both dated 18.09.2019 issued by Tehsildar, Jind.

Respondent No.7 belongs to Uttar Pradesh or Delhi which is evident from her Scheduled Caste Certificate dated 17.07.2001 issued by SDM, Najafgarh,
Delhi.

Tehsildar, Jind in view of judgement dated 05.08.2025 passed by Civil Judge (JD), Jind has Surekha vs State Of Haryana And Others on 22 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62739102/

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has submitted representation dated 13.11.2025 after cancellation of resident and Caste Certificate of respondent No. 7.
5.
Learned State counsel submits that Competent Authority would look into representation dated 13.11.2025 of the petitioner and pass an appropriate orders within three months from today.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner agrees to the aforesaid arrangement.
7. In the wake of statement of both sides, the petition stands disposed of.
It is hereby made clear that no adverse order shall be passed against respondent No. 7 without granting her opportunity of hearing.
